annotations.title: Find good days in a month

description: Ranks the days of one Gregorian month for an activity (wedding, opening a shop, moving house, signing a contract, travel…) by Vietnamese day-selection rules, optionally checked against the birth years of the people involved. Returns the best days with reasons and good hours, and the days to avoid.

activity.description: Activity: viec-chung = Việc chung; cuoi-hoi = Cưới hỏi; an-hoi = Ăn hỏi; khai-truong = Khai trương; nhap-trach = Nhập trạch, chuyển nhà; dong-tho = Động thổ; lam-nha = Làm nhà, sửa nhà; mua-xe = Mua xe; ky-hop-dong = Ký hợp đồng; xuat-hanh = Xuất hành

birth_year.description: Birth year of the person doing it (for weddings: the bride)

partner_birth_year.description: Weddings and engagements only: birth year of the groom
